three_judgments.path: Mechanism = depressed cyclical re-rate on operating leverage + cost-out as ag cycle turns. Mid-cycle (2023) adj-EBITDA $205M, peak (2022) $253M vs trough (2026 guide) ~$110M — real ~2x EBITDA recovery power. But equity geometry caps LOW: EV ~$910M (cap ~$469M + net debt $441M); mid-cycle $200M EBITDA at 6-7x -> equity ~$760-960M = ~1.6-2x; full PEAK $250M at 6.5-7.5x -> ~$1.19-1.44B = ~2.5-3.1x. Reaching 4x needs above-peak ~$290M EBITDA AND ~8-9x multiple together = heroic. Discriminators (§7): SHOWS zero of four cleanly — only 'inflection' is restructuring-driven (~$5M/yr savings, trivial vs $441M debt); Q1 cash-flow inflection is NEGATIVE (-$60M FCF, net debt rose); order 'bottoming' is industry narrative not TWI firm-order acceleration (asserts, doesn't show); mgmt EXPLICITLY dates ag recovery to 2027, EMC alone (+11%) carrying the quarter — answering the pin-down NO. Honest ceiling ~2-3x; fails the ≥4x multibagger bar and fails the high-confidence/protected 3-4x great-trade bar.
three_judgments.asymmetry: Weak/marginal. Bull (full peak re-rate, multi-year, uncertain cycle turn) ~+150-200%; base (slow stabilization) roughly flat-to-modest; bear (ag trough persists into 2027 + ~4.3x leverage + negative FCF + 2028 7% notes refi into higher-rate window) ~-40-50%. ~4.3x leverage amplifies downside; prob-weighted U/D roughly symmetric (~1:1) — does not clearly dominate.
three_judgments.survival: Clears — NOT ruin. Net debt $441M, ~4.3x trough leverage, $400M 7.00% notes due 2028, interest ~$40M/yr, currently negative FCF, BUT $171.3M cash + serviceable + no going-concern flag (§9 does not auto-disqualify). Leverage is the binding tension that hollows out J1/J2 (2028 refi risk + cash burn cap the equity re-rate), not a permanent-impairment death-spiral.

strongest_bear: ~$441M net debt at ~4.3x trough leverage means even a full mid-cycle EBITDA recovery to ~$200M re-rates the equity only ~2x; ag recovery not until 2027 (mgmt), EMC alone carrying the quarter, FCF negative, and a 7% 2028 note must be refinanced into a higher-rate window — a cheap, serviceable, leveraged cyclical with a ceiling-limited re-rate, not a venture-book shot.
